_comment: MOCK: hand-written demo responses for /api/ask, used only while CONFIG.USE_MOCK is true. Not real retrieval output. Passage texts are short paraphrases for UI testing; the real passages come from data/schemes/ via the API.

answers.en: Under PM-KISAN, landholding farmer families get ₹6,000 a year, paid in three instalments of ₹2,000 directly to their bank account [S1]. Income-tax payers are not eligible [S2].
answers.hi: पीएम-किसान के तहत भूमिधारक किसान परिवारों को साल में ₹6,000 तीन किस्तों में सीधे बैंक खाते में मिलते हैं [S1]। आयकर देने वाले पात्र नहीं हैं [S2]।
answers.gu: PM-KISAN હેઠળ જમીન ધરાવતા ખેડૂત પરિવારોને વર્ષે ₹6,000 ત્રણ હપ્તામાં સીધા બેંક ખાતામાં મળે છે [S1]. આવકવેરો ભરનારા પાત્ર નથી [S2].
answers.hinglish: PM-KISAN mein zameen wale kisan parivaron ko saal mein ₹6,000 teen kiston mein seedhe bank account mein milte hain [S1]. Income tax bharne wale eligible nahi hain [S2].

citations.passage: MOCK passage: Financial benefit of ₹6,000 per year in three equal instalments of ₹2,000 to landholding farmer families, transferred to their bank accounts.
MOCK passage: Families in which one or more members paid income tax in the last assessment year are excluded.

answers.en: For PM Awas Yojana you will usually need your Aadhaar card, an income certificate, bank account details and proof that you don't own a pucca house [S1].
answers.hi: पीएम आवास योजना के लिए आम तौर पर आधार कार्ड, आय प्रमाण पत्र, बैंक खाते का विवरण और यह प्रमाण कि आपके पास पक्का घर नहीं है, चाहिए [S1]।
answers.gu: PM આવાસ યોજના માટે સામાન્ય રીતે આધાર કાર્ડ, આવકનો દાખલો, બેંક ખાતાની વિગતો અને તમારી પાસે પાકું ઘર નથી તેનો પુરાવો જોઈએ [S1].
answers.hinglish: PM Awas Yojana ke liye aam taur par Aadhaar card, income certificate, bank account details aur yeh proof chahiye ki aapke paas pucca ghar nahi hai [S1].

citations.passage: MOCK passage: Documents required: Aadhaar card, income certificate, bank account details, and a declaration that the family does not own a pucca house.

answers.en: Sorry, this information is not in my scheme documents. Please check myscheme.gov.in or visit your nearest CSC centre.
answers.hi: माफ़ कीजिए, यह जानकारी मेरे योजना दस्तावेज़ों में नहीं है। कृपया myscheme.gov.in देखें या नज़दीकी CSC केंद्र पर जाएँ।
answers.gu: માફ કરશો, આ માહિતી મારા યોજના દસ્તાવેજોમાં નથી. કૃપા કરીને myscheme.gov.in જુઓ અથવા નજીકના CSC કેન્દ્રની મુલાકાત લો.
answers.hinglish: Maaf kijiye, yeh jaankari mere scheme documents mein nahi hai. Kripya myscheme.gov.in dekhiye ya nazdeeki CSC centre jaiye.
